narrative.summary: **Weekly Monitoring Summary** - **Catalog:** 6 models added (e.g., nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free, poolside/laguna-s-2.1-free); 5 removed (including cline-pass/mimo-v2.5-pro). - **Blend changes:** Kimi K3 rose sharply from 6.469 to 19.087 (+195%); GLM 5.3 Flash fell from 0.050 to 0.045; MiniMax M3 dropped from 0.490 to 0.228 (−53%). - **Rates:** DeepSeek V4.1 Flash rates roughly halved across all classes (e.g., input 0.3 → 0.150), with provenance shifting from reference to measured—values not directly comparable. - **Quality:** No changes.
